newsitem.title: UK: Claremont names new chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Claremont names new chief executive.

text.p: British textile manufacturer Claremont Garments (Holdings) Plc said on Thursday Peter Wiegand, currently chairman and chief executive relinquish his role as chief executive, but remain as chairman.
John Gilliat, a non-executive director of the group since March, will become chief executive from September 10.

Gilliat was with United Biscuits from 1982 to 1996. Most recently he was managing director of the Ross Young's division, where he was involved in supplying Marks and Spencer Plc, Claremont's main customer.

Claremont also said it plans to sell its subsidiary Bellrise Fashions Limited, which serves customers other than M&S, principally Next Plc. The sale will focus Claremont's activities entirely on servicing M&S.
